objective: Produce truthful evidence of real external workflow/stakeholder discovery and problem decomposition before solution design.
truth_rules: Company research, job-post analysis, market intelligence, and candidate targeting are not customer discovery.
A real external participant must exist; label the relationship exactly (customer, pilot user, collaborator, tester, team, organization).
Do not invent interviews, pain points, stakeholder quotes, workflow observations, requirements, or outcomes.
Discovery evidence must precede or be independently separable from the final solution so the problem was not reverse-engineered from the artifact.

evidence: participant confirmation or correction of the problem framing

acceptance: At least one real external participant provides or validates workflow information.
The exact relationship to the participant is recorded without inflating it to 'customer'.
Raw discovery notes or a permission-safe derivative exist.
A current-state workflow/problem map and ranked bottleneck/opportunity set are produced.
Constraints, non-goals, authority boundaries, and success criteria are explicit.
At least one participant correction, clarification, or validation of the problem framing is recorded.
A public-safe case study is created only from information permitted for publication.
Evidence is ingested into evidence-sources.json with lineage and limitations.
claim_ceiling: This packet can establish real external discovery/problem decomposition. It does not establish deployment, adoption, customer success, or production operation unless those are separately observed and receipted.
